name: Group Header 117
definition: Provides further details on the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the account owner or the party authorised to send the message, and sent to the account servicing institution, to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The sender has to make sure that 'MessageIdentification' is unique per account servicing institution for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

MessageSender.name: Message Sender
MessageSender.definition: Identification of the party that is sending the message, when different from the account owner.
